## Problem
Describe the issue without patient-level information.

## Evidence
Reference the file, table, code location, and commit. Identify the relevant cohort and denominator.

## Expected result
Describe the correction or clarification and its scientific implications.

## Reproduction
Provide a minimal synthetic example if needed. Do not attach source data or clinical records.
